name: Langdale
description: Langdale is the region the party calls home. During the session on 2026-08-03, the party observed that a forest visible through a portal appeared to share the same flora and fauna as the forests surrounding Langdale and around their stronghold. Walker recognized a familiar tree from his past travels, which further suggested the portal's destination lay somewhere in the vicinity of Langdale. Together, these observations indicate the portal may connect to a forest near the party's homeland, though the exact location was not confirmed without entering the portal.
